mcp_servers.description: Per-MCP-server policy overlays for MCP servers contributed by this plugin.

PluginMcpServerConfig.description:
Policy settings for a plugin-provided MCP server.

This intentionally excludes transport settings: plugin manifests own how the MCP server is launched, while user config owns enablement and tool policy.

default_tools_approval_mode.description: Approval mode for tools in this server unless a tool override exists.

disabled_tools.description: Explicit deny-list of tools. These tools are removed after applying `enabled_tools`.

enabled.description: When `false`, Codex skips initializing this plugin MCP server.

enabled_tools.description: Explicit allow-list of tools exposed from this server.

tools.description: Per-tool policy settings keyed by tool name.

McpServerToolConfig.description: Per-tool settings for a single MCP server tool.

output_token_limit.description: Token budget for this tool's output, before the standard 20% serialization allowance.

model_result_rules.codex: No source model runner. Converted declarations use native rules, never claude rules inferred from spelling.
model_result_rules.native_impossible: With ok=false at Stop/SubagentStop, prompt may stop without correction; gate remains unmet. Else ignored for prompt; invalid on agent.
model_result_rules.native_continueOnBlock: not a native option; conversion must display native outcome instead of silently carrying the source setting
host_overrides: A source no-decision handler cannot be registered as a required policy gate; use explicit native conversion to request that role.
No ok=true grants permission, proves a check or accepts a task. It satisfies only that handler decision for its exact admission key.
Any requested correction or continued work consumes the same cumulative allowance. Exhaustion or cancellation stops it with unmet gates.
impossible and end-turn outcomes stop execution without completing or accepting task work; unresolved policy remains visible.
Unknown model response fields fail strict validation; invalid agent impossible and invalid agent continueOnBlock are visible activation/result errors.
Model handlers produce no WorktreeCreate path or rewritten elicitation content. A native allowing gate still needs the admitted host/provider operation to produce that special result.
An observation-only event cannot carry a required gate. Invalid observer output is visible without retroactively blocking the observed action.

conditions.continueOnBlock: Boolean from validated prompt configuration; defaults false
conditions.impossible: Boolean from validated prompt response; defaults false; tested only with ok=false
conditions.teammate-stop: Trusted event-owner origin equals teammate-stop; otherwise origin must be tool-transition

outcomes.no-source-decision: Discard this model verdict; retain original permission/denial flow. This handler cannot discharge or act as a required gate.
outcomes.end-turn-unmet: End current model execution. Do not publish a blocked pending transition or mark task work completed. Retain unmet policy.
outcomes.continue-after-result: Keep original tool receipt, add attributed feedback and permit bounded follow-up; the false verdict does not satisfy completion policy.
outcomes.continue-with-failure: Keep the original failed operation, add feedback and permit bounded follow-up without retrying its effect automatically.
outcomes.deny-tool-and-continue: Do not execute the pending tool. Return the denial as feedback; permit bounded follow-up under fresh admission.
outcomes.deny-tool-and-end-turn: Do not execute the pending tool. End model execution and retain the denial and unmet policy.
outcomes.stop-unmet: Stop this task/child execution without another correction. Retain the required unmet gate; never publish completion or acceptance.
outcomes.bounded-correction: Return the reason as attributed correction work only within the original remaining allowance; otherwise stop-unmet.
outcomes.reject-and-continue: Reject the pending task transition; return its error as feedback and permit bounded follow-up.
outcomes.keep-working: Do not complete the task or enter the proposed idle state; continue the existing assignment within its remaining allowance.
outcomes.hold-pending-action: Do not execute/publish the pending action; retain the reason and wait for a fresh admitted decision.
outcomes.bounded-correction-or-stop-unmet: Request a correction under the existing allowance; otherwise stop with the gate unmet. Post-operation receipts remain unchanged.
outcomes.attributed-observation-only: Retain the model observation without blocking, undoing or approving an operation; required-gate registration is invalid here.
